title: Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) — Changes to an In-Force Policy
content:
# Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) — Changes to an In-Force Policy

An insured may change how a Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) policy is billed, add coverage at an increase anniversary, cancel, or convert; the rules for each, and the standing nature of the coverage, are as follows.

## 1. Billing frequency and payment method

The insured may change the billing frequency or payment method at any time, effective with the next due date.

*Hypothetical:* an insured billed monthly asks on 12 March to move to quarterly billing. The change takes effect with the next due date, 1 April.

## 2. Coverage increases

At each increase anniversary (every 5 years from the coverage date) up to age 60, the insured may add $25,000 without health questions up to $500,000. Increases are processed by the insurance service, not on a service call.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| When | at each increase anniversary, every 5 years from the coverage date |
| Age limit | up to age 60; after age 60 no further increases are available |
| Amount | $25,000, without health questions |
| Ceiling | $500,000 of coverage |
| Who processes it | the insurance service; it is not processed on a service call |

*Hypothetical:* coverage dated 1 June 2012 has increase anniversaries on 1 June 2017, 1 June 2022 and 1 June 2027. An insured holding $200,000 who is 52 at the 2022 anniversary may add $25,000 without health questions, bringing coverage to $225,000.

## 3. Cancellation and conversion

Cancelling or converting is the insured's own decision. Conversion is to an individual commercial policy with a participating insurer, and needs no health evidence.

Premiums paid for coverage after the cancellation or conversion date are refunded when at least $1.00, without interest. An overpaid amount below $1.00 is credited forward rather than refunded.

*Hypothetical:* an insured whose monthly premium is $17.00 paid a quarterly premium of $51.00 covering July through September and cancels with a cancellation date of 30 June. All three months of that premium are coverage after the cancellation date; the $51.00 is refunded, and no interest is added.

| Premium paid for coverage after the cancellation or conversion date | Result |
|---|---|
| $1.00 or more | refunded, without interest |
| less than $1.00 | not refunded; credited forward |

## 4. Standing features of the coverage

The policy has no cash value, no loans and no dividends, and renews for life in terms of 5 years.

## Points of judgement

- *Can the representative add an increase on the call?* No. Increases are processed by the insurance service, not on a service call.
- *Does a change from monthly to annual billing take effect today?* It takes effect with the next due date.
- *Is health evidence needed to convert?* No. Conversion needs no health evidence.
- *Who decides to cancel or convert?* The insured; cancelling or converting is the insured's own decision.
